mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 500,000 units per month signals weakening consumer demand and reduced construction activity, which typically precedes a slowdown in economic growth and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when HOUST falls below 500.0, or the Rank IC is negative over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment rate and declines in non-farm payrolls indicate a deteriorating labor market, which signals reduced consumer spending power and corporate earnings pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising UNRATE and falling PAYEMS fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY), a decline in the federal funds rate signals aggressive monetary easing to combat economic slowdown, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0 and FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate signals a tightening labor market, which typically boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE declines, or the Rank IC is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year increase in the CPI index above 3.0% signals persistent inflation, which typically leads to a Federal Reserve rate hike and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0, or the Rank IC is negative over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in consumer spending (RSAFS) and industrial production (INDPRO) signal a broad-based economic slowdown, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of declining RSAFS and INDPRO fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, a decline in housing starts below 520.0 units signals a potential peak in the business cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion, when HOUST falls below 520.0, SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC for the signal in late-cycle expansion is below 0.03.
